description: Persistent thinking sessions with full context access for AI agents. Stores thinking data in dedicated database with auto-connect to Vodou for context enrichment.
reminder_message: 🧠 Vodou-Enhanced-Thinking provides persistent thinking sessions with full context access. All thinking data is stored in thinking.db (in MCP server directory) with auto-connect to Vodou database for context enrichment. Use start_thinking_session to begin, then add_thought for each step. Access previous thoughts with get_thought_context. Analyze quality with analyze_thinking. Sessions persist across multiple calls!

notes.database: thinking.db lives in MCP-servers/Vodou-Enhanced-Thinking/ directory. Auto-connects to vodou-core.db (read-only) for Vodou context enrichment.
notes.state_persistence: All thoughts are persisted in thinking.db, accessible across multiple vodou-core calls
notes.oi_integration: Automatically enriches thinking data with Vodou context (sessions, agent history, skill info) when available
notes.standalone_mode: Works even if Vodou database is not available - gracefully degrades to standalone mode
